source: Rob review meeting and Sell outline, 2026-07-28

cases.input: Sell insurance policies and investment instruments
cases.expectedOutcome: Evaluate as a service or entitlement rather than defaulting to information.

cases.input: Bicycles and bicycle accessories are flat siblings while a sporting-equipment category is available.
cases.expectedOutcome: Test the existing sporting-equipment parent before creating a new category.

cases.input: A flower-selling activity is separate from an existing agricultural-products category.
cases.expectedOutcome: Test placement under the existing agricultural-products parent.

cases.input: A food-specialty activity is separate from an existing food-and-beverage category.
cases.expectedOutcome: Test placement under the existing food-and-beverage parent.

cases.input: Two activities differ only by chip versus token and their evidence is substitutable.
cases.expectedOutcome: Propose identity only after checking all source-task meanings.

cases.input: Two activities differ only by a singular or plural service label.
cases.expectedOutcome: Treat number variation as a candidate, not sufficient proof of identity.

cases.input: Admission pass and admission ticket have substitutable evidence.
cases.expectedOutcome: Propose identity when the evidence confirms the same activity.

cases.input: Postal products and postal supplies may overlap but their source tasks must be inspected.
cases.expectedOutcome: Require evidence before merging related object categories.

cases.input: Equipment and items may overlap but have no supplied identity evidence.
cases.expectedOutcome: Do not merge broad related categories from wording alone.

cases.input: A long flat list contains stable domain clusters, including some two-member clusters.
cases.expectedOutcome: Allow evidence-supported groups with two or more members.

cases.input: A miscellaneous or other collection duplicates an explicit what dimension.
cases.expectedOutcome: Raise a policy proposal that accounts for every child; do not silently remove anything.

cases.input: One task names products and services, a specific product node is created, and broad product and service parents already exist.
cases.expectedOutcome: Keep the specific product output and justified service parent; remove a superseded broad product edge.

cases.input: A temporary-usage wrapper has one rent-out child and lease-out is recorded as a synonym.
cases.expectedOutcome: Test coextensiveness and preserve the lexical synonym; do not collapse without checking for other meanings.
